messages:
Elaine Park: Quick sync — we need the final asset manifest for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. Logos, screenshots, AMI IDs, offer metadata, pricing-tier mapping, and EULA text. Targeting next Tue for submission. Who owns what?
Ashley Rivera: I can coordinate packaging and the submission windows. @Elaine can you confirm which SKUs/plans we want to expose first? :calendar:
Elaine Park: Start with Core and Dedicated plans. Add a free trial SKU for hosted. Dedicated = reserved capacity SKU.
Sara Li (Product): Core = pay-as-you-go, Dedicated = monthly commit SKU, Trial = 14-day trial SKU. I'll drop a simple mapping later today.
Kevin O'Neil: For AWS AMIs — we need AMI IDs per region and a consistent name. I'm running the AMI bake tomorrow. Naming conv: redwood-inference-ami-<version>-<region>. I'll upload manifest to S3 at s3://redwood-marketplace/manifests/<version>.json
Jun Kim: Logo sizes: 1024x1024 primary, 512x512 alt, SVG for web. Screenshots: 1200x628 (hero), plus 4 x 800x600 product shots. Provide transparent PNG for marketplace icons.
Matt H. (Legal): FYI — AWS/GCP require a vendor EULA and a privacy blurb. Use the org EULA template 2025-v2. Also need export control checkbox language. I'll attach finalized copy in the doc.
marketplace-bot: AWS required fields checklist: OfferName, ShortDescription(200 chars), LongDescription(4000 chars), SupportContacts, TermsURL, AMIIdsByRegion, PricingDimensionIDs. See docs: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/tour/
Kevin O'Neil: Quick manifest example I'm going to push:
```json
{
  "version": "2026-03-01",
  "offers": [
    {"sku": "CORE-PAID", "plan": "core", "pricing": "payg"},
    {"sku": "DEDICATED-1", "plan": "dedicated", "pricing": "monthly"}
  ],
  "amis": {"us-east-1": "ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h", "eu-west-1": "ami-0h7g6f5e4d3c2b1a"}
}
```
Kevin O'Neil: We also need a test account for AWS listing previews and a partner sandbox for validation. Can infra spin a preview account? @Ashley
Ashley Rivera: I'll request preview accounts from AWS partner support today. Timeline: request = Wed, expected creds = Fri.
Jun Kim: I'll drop compressed assets (SVG + PNGs) into the asset bucket: s3://redwood-marketplace/assets/<version>/
Sara Li (Product): Product notes for listing long description: call out unified runtime, dedicated capacity, private deployment options, and cost controls. Keep first-paragraph short for marketplace preview.
Matt H. (Legal): Reminder — any marketing claims about SLAs need approval. We can say "SLA-backed latency targets" but exact numbers need Legal sign-off from contracts.
Elaine Park: Action items: 1) Kevin — AMIs + manifest by EOD tomorrow. 2) Jun — logos/screens + hero images by EOD. 3) Sara — SKU mapping + copy by EOD. 4) Matt — EULA + export language by EOD. 5) Ashley — request preview accounts today and coordinate submission window. Deadline: submit on Monday morning to hit Tuesday live.
Kevin O'Neil: Ack. Will include a small test script for partners to validate AMI boot and health check.
Ashley Rivera: Also coordinating GCP/Azure equivalents: GCP needs VM image URIs and Marketplace package.yaml; Azure needs Managed Application template and offer IDs. I'll create a checklist per cloud and share in this thread.
Elaine Park: Perfect. Ping me if anything blocks approvals. :+1:
marketplace-bot: Note — publishing windows vary by cloud: AWS ~48-72h review, GCP ~3-5 business days, Azure ~5-7 business days. Plan accordingly.
Elaine Park: Thanks team — will follow up with a consolidated doc and timeline later today.
